blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. was arrested in Quezon City on Saturday morning by virtue of a warrant of arrest for cyberlibel issued by a Davao court. Police arrested Lustre in a restaurant in Quezon City where the Saturday News Forum was held. READ: SC affirms ruling on cyberlibel prescription period Lawyer Atty. Dino De Leon, who was also present at the conference, told reporters that he will stand as his legal counsel. “It is not the usual course of things na hindi ka mabigyan ng right to respond.
